specs.title: Inbound WhatsApp webhook and routing
specs.why: Two-way messaging is the precondition for the conversational booking agent.
specs.scope: Receive inbound WhatsApp messages, identify the business phone number, route to the correct tenant, and persist conversation and message history per client.
tasks: Route by `to` number to the tenant
Continuity for known clients by phone lookup
acceptance: An incoming message is persisted with the correct `tenantId`
An unknown number receives the greeting template
A known client is resumed without re-asking identity

specs.title: Booking agent happy path
specs.why: Conversational booking is the product's core differentiator.
specs.scope: LLM tool-using agent that books a service over WhatsApp. Tools: `list_services`, `check_availability`, `hold_slot`, `confirm_booking`, `send_payment_link`. Slot holds expire in 15 minutes.
tasks: Agent runtime with a tool registry
E2E test: book haircut Saturday 2pm, payment link, confirmed
acceptance: The happy-path E2E passes in the test harness
Tool calls are tenant-scoped and cannot reach another tenant
A held slot releases after 15 minutes if unpaid
